description: Emma (by Stimhaus) builds a live website for an AI agent from its facts, in one call, and edits it from plain-language requests. No account and no key needed to start. Free for the first 1000 agents. Use when asked to "make a website for my agent", "give my agent a homepage", "create a landing page for this agent", "put my agent online", "my agent needs a public page", "show what my agent does", or "add my agent's links / logo / capabilities to its site".

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
